_comment: Air Corridors (UX redesign v2): curated tactical lanes per map+era. Selecting one orients the mission's THREAT AXIS down the lane and concentrates enemy air defenses + CAP toward its far (enemy) end. Geometry is a compass BEARING (degrees, from the friendly side toward the enemy) + REACH (metres to the enemy focus), so it is map-agnostic and needs no per-corridor lat/lon. 'axis'/'enemy' are briefing text. NO player waypoints are placed — this shapes the ENEMY picture and the threat axis only.  terrain_note (optional): a plain-English caveat about the GROUND under the lane, briefed verbatim. Added Aug 2026 because DCS: Iraq ships only its North region in detail — the southern band a corridor may cross is present but low-detail until ED releases Iraq South, and a pilot should be told that rather than discover it.

caucasus.name: Black Sea Coastal Push
caucasus.axis: Ingress up the Black Sea littoral

persiangulf.name: Bandar Abbas Strike Lane
persiangulf.axis: Gulf to the coast naval base

syria.axis: Southbound toward the capital SAM ring

nevada.name: Range 74 Threat Axis

afghanistan.axis: Up the river valley to the green zone

afghanistan.name: Helmand Green Zone
afghanistan.axis: South-west down the river into the green zone
afghanistan.enemy: MANPADS, DShK on compounds, no air

afghanistan.name: Khost Bowl
afghanistan.axis: East to the bowl and the passes behind it
afghanistan.enemy: Heavy machine guns on the ridgelines + MANPADS

afghanistan.name: Kunar Valley

iraq.enemy: MIM-23 HAWK on the island + IRIAF F-14A/F-4E + ZSU-23-4
iraq.terrain_note: The ground under the southern half of this lane is DCS: Iraq's low-detail band — Eagle Dynamics has shipped only the North region so far. The geometry and the threat picture are real; the scenery down there is generic until Iraq South releases.

iraq.terrain_note: The ground under the southern half of this lane is DCS: Iraq's low-detail band — Eagle Dynamics has shipped only the North region so far. The geometry and the threat picture are real; the scenery down there is generic until Iraq South releases.
